reports.title: C Engineers
reports.query:
MATCH (p:Person)-[:HAS_SKILL]->(s:Skill {skill_name: "C"})
WHERE 
    p.person_name IS NOT NULL AND p.person_name <> "" AND
    (p.person_email IS NOT NULL AND p.person_email <> "" OR
     p.person_phone IS NOT NULL AND p.person_phone <> "")
RETURN 
    p.person_name AS name, 
    p.person_email AS email, 
    p.person_phone AS phone,
    COALESCE(p.person_gender, "Unknown") AS gender,
    COALESCE(p.person_age, "Unknown") AS age,
    COALESCE(p.person_national, "Unknown") AS national

reports.title: Gender Ratio
reports.query:
MATCH (p:Person)
WITH 
    CASE 
        WHEN p.person_gender IN ["Female", "F", "FEMALE"] THEN "Female"
        WHEN p.person_gender IN ["Male", "M", "MALE"] THEN "Male"
    END AS gender
WHERE gender IN ["Female", "Male", "Not specified"]
WITH 
    gender, 
    COUNT(*) AS count
RETURN 
    gender, 
    count,
    toFloat(count) / toFloat(sum(count)) * 100 AS percentage

reports.title: Project Description
reports.query:
## Knowledge Graph Construction

In the information age, unstructured data such as text and images are emerging in vast quantities. A key focus of data governance is transforming this unstructured data into structured knowledge graphs, which can support further exploration of potential value within the data. These knowledge graphs can power applications like intelligent question answering, recommendation systems.

reports.title: Age Distribution
reports.query:
MATCH (p:Person)
WHERE p.person_age IS NOT NULL
WITH 
    toInteger(p.person_age) /1 * 1 AS age_group, 
    COUNT(*) AS total
WHERE age_group IS NOT NULL
RETURN 
    age_group, 
    total
ORDER BY age_group ASC

reports.title: Nationality Heat Map
reports.query:
MATCH (p:Person)-[:LIVES_IN]->(l:Location)
WITH l.location_country AS country, count(DISTINCT p) AS job_seekers
WHERE country IS NOT NULL
WITH 
    CASE 
        WHEN country = "India" THEN "IND"
        WHEN country = "Hungary" THEN "HUN"
        WHEN country = "Kenya" THEN "KEN"
        WHEN country = "USA" THEN "USA"
        WHEN country = "Qatar" THEN "QAT"
        WHEN country = "KSA" THEN "SAU"
        WHEN country = "UAE" THEN "ARE"
        WHEN country = "Mauritius" THEN "MUS"
        WHEN country = "Thailand" THEN "THA"
        WHEN country = "Bahrain" THEN "BHR"
        WHEN country = "Malaysia" THEN "MYS"
        WHEN country = "Singapore" THEN "SGP"
        WHEN country = "Oman" THEN "OMN"
        WHEN country = "Germany" THEN "DEU"
        WHEN country = "Ireland" THEN "IRL"
        WHEN country = "Ukraine" THEN "UKR"
        WHEN country = "Romania" THEN "ROU"
        WHEN country = "Netherlands" THEN "NLD"
        WHEN country = "Syria" THEN "SYR"
        WHEN country = "Pakistan" THEN "PAK"
        WHEN country = "United States" THEN "USA"
        WHEN country = "Lebanon" THEN "LBN"
        WHEN country = "Denmark" THEN "DNK"
        WHEN country = "Switzerland" THEN "CHE"
        WHEN country = "Bangladesh" THEN "BGD"
        WHEN country = "Sultanate of Oman" THEN "OMN"
        WHEN country = "United Arab Emirates" THEN "ARE"
        WHEN country = "Egypt" THEN "EGY"
        WHEN country = "Botswana" THEN "BWA"
        WHEN country = "Canada" THEN "CAN"
        WHEN country = "UK" THEN "GBR"
        WHEN country = "Saudi Arabia" THEN "SAU"
        WHEN country = "Gulf" THEN NULL
        WHEN country = "INDIA" THEN "IND"
        WHEN country = "China" THEN "CHN"
        WHEN country = "Sri Lanka" THEN "LKA"
        WHEN country = "Kuwait" THEN "KWT"
        WHEN country = "Iraq" THEN "IRQ"
        ELSE NULL
    END AS country_code,
    job_seekers
WHERE country_code IS NOT NULL
WITH country_code, SUM(job_seekers) AS total_job_seekers
RETURN country_code, total_job_seekers

reports.title: Has_Skill Relationships
reports.query:
MATCH (p:Person)-[r:HAS_SKILL]->(s:Skill)
WHERE s.skill_name IN ["C", "C++", "JAVA"]
RETURN p, r, s
LIMIT 20

reports.title: Organizations In India
reports.query:
MATCH (o:Organization)-[r:LOCATED_IN]->(l:Location)
WHERE l.location_country = "India"
RETURN o, r, l
LIMIT 10
